reasons.overallMobile: Coherent atmospheric mission with useful assistance and clear progression; target acquisition failures and dense small-screen information temper the rating.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement/fire drag and scene turn worked in sampled engagements, but two COVER bursts required correction. Much navigation and aiming was assisted; continuous hold comfort unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Observed recovery, patrols, three-coil timing phase and uplink defense supplied understandable variety. Assistance supported progress but limits conclusions about manual traversal, challenge and sustained enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rain, reflective ground, cyan/amber palette and industrial silhouettes gave a cohesive atmosphere; end-screen typography was clear. Audio not assessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach holds, progress banners, large map destination buttons and explicit fresh restart were helpful. Context changes add learning overhead.
reasons.readability: Objective, ammo and end stats were readable, but tiny enemies, small map legend and competing translucent HUD panels made scanning harder.

unassessed: Pure unassisted aiming and extended manual navigation
